context: Continued-context cross-review, not a fresh-context or blinded benchmark
review_basis: Actual Playwright Chromium output at 1440×1000 and 390×844
Updated FORM Unslop signals and repair guidance

reading_path_assessment.observation: The page identifies the desk, shows Loans and the active count, then puts search and status filtering immediately above a comparison table. Selected-loan facts and the local return action occupy the supporting desktop pane. Phone rows preserve each required fact and expose Open.
reading_path_assessment.decision: Preserve the navy/blue/system-sans identity and useful density. No structural redesign or removal of operational facts is indicated by the reviewed views.

signals.observation: Filters are plain text tabs with active underline and derived counts. Loan states and Offline demo are plain text, not pills.
signals.reason: Each label communicates an actual filter, loan state or demo scope. Retain this status recognition.

signals.location: All rendered UI and inline SVG
signals.observation: No italic text was observed; computed inventory found no italic elements.
signals.reason: Upright text supports rapid scanning without ornamental emphasis.

signals.observation: The approved system sans stack is used. No Instrument Serif or external font is present.
signals.reason: Preserve the supplied sans identity.

signals.observation: No negative tracking was observed or found in computed styles. Long borrower names wrap at enlarged text without letter collisions.
signals.reason: Natural tracking preserves legibility.

signals.location: Loans workspace, counts and detail panel
signals.observation: The surface consists of the actual six-loan comparison, search, status filters, selected-loan facts, local return and undo. Counts are derived from the records and changed correctly.
signals.reason: This is necessary desk workflow density, not decorative analytics or simulated controls.

signals.observation: Rules separate records, table labels, loan facts from the return action, and the footer. The filter underline identifies selection.
signals.reason: The boundaries support comparison and distinguish an action region; they are not repeated ornamental framing around prose.

signals.observation: The navy, blue and cool off-white identity is preserved. Status colors have text equivalents; primary/secondary text has coherent roles. The amber focus outline measures 2.00:1 against white and 1.83:1 against the canvas.
signals.reason: Keep the brand and semantic state colors; strengthen only the focus-indicator contrast rather than globally changing opacity.

signals.observation: Borders identify input/action affordances and the two meaningful workspace regions: loan comparison and selected-loan actions. Mobile keeps one record list rather than a set of unrelated promo cards.
signals.reason: Removing these boundaries would weaken selection, field recognition and dense record scanning.

signals.location: Inline equipment, search, brand and confirmation SVGs
signals.observation: There are no diagrams. Small line icons depict equipment categories, search, close, a local device and return confirmation. No technical labels, fabricated relationships or SVG typography are used.
signals.reason: These lightweight icons support the actual equipment desk subject and do not substitute a fake technical diagram for content.

signals.observation: Local/demo limitations repeat near consequential actions and global scope, with distinct purposes. The desktop keyboard hint inaccurately promises Escape will close the permanent detail pane.
signals.reason: Retain the honest local-return qualifiers and equipment-return instruction. Make only the Escape instruction match the current layout.

signals.observation: L-1042 through L-1047 are real supplied loan identifiers used for search and record recognition. There are no decorative file paths, build strings or fake code.
signals.reason: Loan identifiers are required operational facts, not implementation decoration.

signals.observation: No ornamental section sequence is present. Numeric loan identifiers and count values refer to actual records.
signals.reason: Preserve IDs and counts; they are needed for the workflow.

signals.location: .brand-description, detail definition terms and state labels
signals.observation: Equipment lending desk describes the product. Borrower, Due and Status label actual fields. There are no repeated pre-heading eyebrow labels.
signals.reason: These terms orient staff and keep facts scannable.

signals.observation: No ASCII/terminal scenery is present.
signals.reason: The interface stays within the actual loan-desk vocabulary and imagery.

signals.observation: No ornamental doodles, hand-drawn underlines or loose marks were observed. SVG strokes depict actual equipment/commands. The selected-row pseudo-element is a straight blue selection bar.
signals.reason: These strokes communicate equipment type or real selection, rather than decorative emphasis.

signals.observation: Body, records and controls use the approved system sans. Monospace appears only in the two keyboard keycaps.
signals.reason: Keycap typography distinguishes actual shortcut keys; it does not turn body copy into a technical costume.

signals.location: Headings, status controls, loan IDs and equipment names
signals.observation: Supporting labels use sentence/title case, not repeated uppercase subtitles. RF, IV and record IDs occur in supplied factual names.
signals.reason: Preserve actual model abbreviations and identifiers.

signals.location: All surfaces, pseudo-elements and inline SVGs
signals.observation: No gradients were observed or found in computed backgrounds. The modal uses a flat translucent navy backdrop.
signals.reason: Flat branded surfaces keep dense information clear; the backdrop identifies the modal layer.

signals.location: Buttons, headings, field labels, notifications and instructions
signals.observation: Short actions and labels have no ornamental terminal periods. Periods occur in complete instructions and state notifications.
signals.reason: Sentence punctuation preserves the meaning of truthful guidance and recovery feedback.

signals.location: States, demo label, brand, icons and pseudo-elements
signals.observation: No decorative colored status dots were observed. States are written in words. Camera lenses/magnifiers are recognizable icon geometry; the selected-row bar marks an actual selected record.
signals.reason: No liveness or availability is implied by an ornamental light. Retain actual selection and state feedback.

signals.location: Open actions, Undo SVG, native status select and other SVGs
signals.observation: Open, reset, close and return actions have no appended arrows. The Undo button has a conventional reverse-arrow icon; the native select has its disclosure affordance.
signals.reason: The Undo arrow refers to the actual required reversal command, and the select arrow exposes a genuine choice list. These are directional/disclosure roles, not outward arrows added to ordinary Open actions.

justified_exceptions.treatment: Row dividers, table/detail boundaries, field/button outlines
justified_exceptions.reason: They support comparison, separate the selected record/action region, and identify actual controls.

justified_exceptions.treatment: Derived counts and real loan identifiers
justified_exceptions.reason: Counts are calculated from the supplied six records; IDs are required for desk lookup, not decorative section numbers or code breadcrumbs.

justified_exceptions.treatment: Local/demo qualifiers near action and global scope
justified_exceptions.reason: They explain the consequence of a return and prevent a fictional device-local change from appearing live.
Only actual keyboard shortcut keys use monospace. Body and record typography preserve approved sans.

justified_exceptions.treatment: Undo reversal icon and native select disclosure
justified_exceptions.reason: They have genuine reversal/disclosure roles. Ordinary Open actions have no appended arrow.

justified_exceptions.treatment: Selected-row blue pseudo-element and confirmation checks
justified_exceptions.reason: They describe actual selection or the outcome of an executed return, without suggesting liveness through ornamental dots.
They depict relevant equipment categories and aid record recognition. They are not invented diagrams or proof.

unresolved_issues.observation: The 3px amber outline (#e9ad30) is visibly present but measures 2.00:1 against the white input surface and 1.83:1 against the cool off-white canvas.
unresolved_issues.consequence: The sole focus treatment has a weak contrast difference from adjacent light surfaces, reducing keyboard-focus clarity.
unresolved_issues.recommended_correction: Use an approved navy/blue focus ring, or a two-colour ring with a contrasting edge. Keep a visible focus indicator and recheck it against white, canvas, selected blue and button surfaces. The approved blue measures 6.48:1 on white.

unresolved_issues.observation: The footer says Esc to close details, but after opening L-1043 and pressing Escape the desktop detail pane stayed visible and unchanged. Escape correctly closed the compact dialog in the phone flow.
unresolved_issues.consequence: The desktop advertises an unavailable dismissal command.
unresolved_issues.recommended_correction: Show the Escape hint only where details use a dialog, or label it specifically as a dialog shortcut. Preserve the persistent desktop details pane unless a real dismiss interaction is intentionally introduced.

unresolved_issues.observation: The unfocused skip link grows to 64.59px high but remains positioned at -60px. Its bottom 4.59px appears as a white strip at the top of the header in both enlarged captures.
unresolved_issues.consequence: A hidden utility control leaks into the rendered header after text enlargement.
unresolved_issues.recommended_correction: Hide the link using its own content height, such as a translateY(-100%) plus offset, and restore it on focus. Preserve the working skip action.

actual_checks.name: Required facts and initial counts
actual_checks.method: Rendered text assertions against all six supplied records
actual_checks.observed: Every ID, person, equipment name, due day/time and initial state was present. Initial totals were 6 active, 2 overdue, 2 due today, 2 on loan, 0 returned.

actual_checks.name: Search and combined status filtering
actual_checks.method: Search Amara, recorder and L-1047; combine Amara with Overdue; reset
actual_checks.observed: Each field found its correct record. Incompatible query/filter showed No matching loans and a reset that cleared query and status. Overdue alone showed two loans.

actual_checks.name: Desktop local return, persistence and undo
actual_checks.method: Open and return L-1043; reload; Undo last return. Sequentially return L-1042 then L-1045 and undo once.
actual_checks.observed: State and relevant counts updated. The L-1043 return persisted in isolated browser storage and undo restored Overdue. With sequential returns, undo restored only L-1045 while L-1042 remained returned. Test storage was reset in the isolated context.

actual_checks.name: Narrow fact discovery and mobile actions
actual_checks.method: Touch context; assert all six records; filter On loan + Alexandria; open L-1044; return and Undo this return
actual_checks.observed: All facts remained in stacked records, including the longest name and equipment. Local return and undo changed state and counts correctly.

actual_checks.name: Dialog close, Escape, focus return and empty reset
actual_checks.method: Escape and visible X close on L-1044; wait for close event; incompatible search; reset
actual_checks.observed: Both dismissal methods worked and focus returned to the L-1044 Open button after the close event. Reset restored all six records. An immediate pre-close-event assertion was not treated as a focus defect.

actual_checks.name: Keyboard search shortcut and focus appearance
actual_checks.method: Press / and inspect focused loan-search outline
actual_checks.observed: Search received focus. The ring uses #e9ad30 at 3px with a 3px offset.

actual_checks.name: Enlarged text and long coupled content
actual_checks.method: Snapshot computed font sizes, double all HTML text sizes in the browser, inspect full-page rows and the already-open L-1044 detail dialog
actual_checks.result: required facts readable; minor skip-link finding CR-03
actual_checks.observed: Names, equipment, due values, state labels and Open actions remained discoverable. The long detail used vertical scrolling: 1127px content within an 812px-tall dialog, with equal 328px client/scroll widths. The 26px return label grew within a 99px-high button and remained reachable at the bottom. No painted-glyph collision was identified in the reviewed required data.

actual_checks.name: All checklist signals, SVGs and pseudo-elements
actual_checks.method: Source inspection, actual captures, bounded computed-style inspector and manual SVG/pseudo review
actual_checks.observed: All original 19 signals plus indicator lights and ordinary-action arrows reviewed. Pseudo-elements are the actual selected-row bar and mobile due punctuation. No italic, negative-tracking or gradient elements were found. Inspector scans stayed below their node cap.

actual_checks.name: Reduced motion, contrast samples and offline behavior
actual_checks.method: Emulate reduced motion, calculate opaque color-pair ratios, monitor requests and page errors in the recorded run
actual_checks.observed: Button transition duration becomes 0s with reduced motion. Muted text measured 5.46:1 on white and 5.00:1 on canvas. Recorded run had zero external requests and zero uncaught JavaScript errors.

limits: Chromium headless and its touch emulation were used; physical devices and other browser engines were not tested.
Doubled-font stress is not actual browser zoom or a complete accessibility audit.
Contrast measurements cover specified opaque pairs, not every state or a full conformance assessment.
Blocked storage, assistive-technology reading order and live backend behavior were not tested. The supplied app is explicitly a local offline demo.
Computed-style candidate observations were interpreted alongside real renders; counts were not converted to a taste score.
This is continued-context cross-review. No handoffs, earlier versions, other case artifacts or evaluation documents were read.
publicationNote: Substantive observations retained; local paths normalized. Audit findings concern the preserved pre-repair snapshot; repair verification concerns the corrected example.
